rationale: The agent performed order-changing writes (two exchanges and one modification) without first confirming with the user, violating the explicit policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. The final message only reported the grill modification and omitted outcome details for the helmet and luggage exchanges, so it did not provide complete final information. The message also introduced specific refund and payment card details (refund amount and Visa last four digits) that are not supported by any shown tool outputs, risking fabrication. While the agent did attempt a form of authentication via name and ZIP lookup and accessed the user’s details, the major issues are unconfirmed writes and incomplete/unsupported final information. Therefore, the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
